## Fixes

- **Switch the extension back on.** After a REAPER crash the extension turns itself off. The connection dialog (click the status at the bottom of the sidebar) now has a "Switch the extension back on" button. Press it and restart REAPER; no more deleting files by hand.
- **Only one Reaper Control.** Starting the app a second time, for example through "Start with this project" while the first one is still reconnecting, now brings the open window to the front instead of opening a second copy.

## Known issues

- The app is not signed yet: macOS and Windows ask for confirmation the first time you open it.
